cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 75% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.74% · WTI -1.50% · Brent +0.05% · NatGas +1.48%. 75% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.35%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.35%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -1.17%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at +6.06%
cards.body: Leaders: SEDG +6.06%, NXT +5.13%, BE +3.90%, WFRD +3.26%, VRT +2.31%. Laggards: NRG -2.20%, CEG -2.08%, LNG -2.03%, BWXT -1.96%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
